gold_sql: SELECT a.artist_id AS artist_id,a.name AS artist_name,SUM(il.unit_price*il.quantity) AS sales_amount FROM public.artist a JOIN public.album al ON al.artist_id=a.artist_id JOIN public.track t ON t.album_id=al.album_id JOIN public.invoice_line il ON il.track_id=t.track_id GROUP BY a.artist_id,a.name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC,a.artist_id ASC LIMIT 1
